title: Example 139: window index held in an int refuses every request after two billion windows
description: Regression proof of Crosscut's Window#counted with the window's index narrowed to an int before the start is computed as index * windowNanos, by the tool's own checker (approach.engine native): expected violation, the witness counted(this=Window[startNanos=0, count=0], nowNanos=2147483648, windowNanos=1), where the old version answers Window[2147483648, 1] and the new one throws IllegalArgumentException from the record's constructor. The library's run took 3 s, the violation found in the stage over the whole range after the two small stages were proved empty. JBMC did not finish within 60 s.

resources.notes: the last run used a stale jvmcontract; measured by the submitting sessions in seconds at under 200 MiB, except 142 at bound 8, 7 s
